title: Owners mourn spoiled food after firmware update bricks Samsung smart fridges
summary: A Samsung smart refrigerator firmware update reportedly bricked units, leaving owners unable to control cooling and causing spoiled food. The incident highlights risks of pushing over-the-air updates to consumer IoT appliances, where a failed deployment can disable core functionality and create real-world consequences. Discussion centers on vendor accountability, update rollback mechanisms, and whether internet-connected appliances should depend on cloud firmware at all.
